what: Panel collector still reads original manifest output/tool instead of waterfall-resolved paths/tools
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed pattern gate can correctly fall a narration-only cursor slot through to codex phase2, but this loop still greps the original cursor output path and records the original vendor, so the usable codex phase2 Recommendation is ignored and the panel can report unparsed or panel-failed despite a successful fallback
suggested_fix: When building panel-outputs.ndjson, zip manifest rows with ALL_OUTPUT_FILES_PATH lines and ALL_OUTPUT_TOOLS in manifest order, then grep and record the resolved path/tool; add a decompose-panel-dispatch harness case where phase1 misses the heading and phase2 supplies it

what: The proposed grep guard treats invalid EREs the same as pattern misses
scenario_or_breakage: The plan says invalid EREs make the dispatcher error, but the suggested if grep -Eq ...; then ...; else failed+=... form swallows grep exit 2 under set -e and silently runs every fallback phase, producing misleading failures and extra launches
suggested_fix: Validate REQUIRE_RESULT_PATTERN once before launching slots and exit 2 on grep rc greater than 1; in collect_phase, distinguish rc 0 accept, rc 1 slot miss, and rc greater than 1 as a dispatcher error

what: The content gate changes STATUS=cap_hit from a terminal budget skip into a fallback trigger
scenario_or_breakage: Existing dispatcher and reviewer threshold contracts treat cap_hit as a deliberate successful slot skip; under the proposed flag, the cap-hit file will not contain ## Recommendation, so the dispatcher can launch alternate externals or Claude after the budget guard already said to skip reviewer fan-out
suggested_fix: Either apply the result-pattern gate only to STATUS=OK and leave cap_hit terminal, or explicitly update the dispatch/token-budget docs and tests to define cap_hit as fallback-eligible under this opt-in flag
